integrity: The universal statement is proved analytically. No finite experiment is used as a substitute for proof. The comparison includes full-text inspection of the foundational full-rank result, the spherical problem statement, and the later frame-operator Wasserstein bound; the 2024 dissertation was available only at abstract level.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats exactly subspace-isotropic spherical sources. It does not determine the closest spherical tight probability for a general source measure, and optimal target measures may be nonunique.
title: Exact spherical isotropization of subspace-isotropic measures
